description: This Kotlin source file defines a RecyclerView adapter for displaying notes in a list within an Android application. It includes the NoteAdapter class, which manages a list of Note objects, creates view holders, binds data to views, and handles item click events.

classes.name: NoteAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of notes with click handling.

classes.name: NoteViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder that binds Note data to item view components.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Replaces the current dataset with a new list and refreshes the RecyclerView.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a Note object to the ViewHolder at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the dataset.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Note object to the ViewHolder's views, setting title and content excerpt.

methods.name: NoteViewHolder.init
methods.description: Initializes click listener for the item view.
